title: Galois unit H2 embeds into etale unit H2
statement: For every field K, there is an embedding Field.GaloisUnitsH2 K ↪ (Spec (.of K)).CohomologicalBrauerGroup. This asserts injectivity in one direction only.

proof.text: Identify the stalk of the units sheaf at the Galois point of the separable closure with the units of the separable closure, Galois-equivariantly, by evaluating germs at the geometric point (`gmSheafFiberGaloisPointAddEquiv` and its action lemma, built from the evaluation equivalence over an algebraically closed field).
Specialize the additive comparison `sheafHAddEquivContinuousCohomology` to the separable closure, the multiplicative sheaf, this stalk equivalence and degree two.
The inverse additive equivalence, after forgetting additivity, is an embedding from Field.GaloisUnitsH2 K to the cohomological Brauer group.

proof_origin.place: The adopted source additive comparison is specialized directly; its inverse toEmbedding replaces the retired duplicate stalk theorem.
